vocabadmin.title: Vocabulary
vocabadmin.subtitle: Rename and recolour statuses, priorities and types. The stored keys never change, so renaming one relabels history too — with no writes.
vocabadmin.adminOnly: Only admins can change the vocabulary.
vocabadmin.kindStatusHint: These are the board's columns, in this order.
vocabadmin.kindPriorityHint: Priorities also carry how long an item may sit quiet, and its service deadline.
vocabadmin.kindTypeHint: What kind of thing an item is.
vocabadmin.frozenHint: Options can't be added or removed — merging two would silently rewrite finished work, and there's no undo.
vocabadmin.label: English label
vocabadmin.labelHint: Leave a label empty to keep the built-in wording for that language.
vocabadmin.labelArHint: Clearing the Arabic label falls back to the built-in Arabic — never to the English one.
vocabadmin.colorHint: One hex value, used in both themes.
vocabadmin.hiddenHint: A hidden option leaves the pickers. Items already holding it keep it, and still show it.
vocabadmin.staleHint: Days without an update before an open item of this priority reads as quiet. Clear it to go back to the default.
vocabadmin.slaHint: Days from creation to finish an item of this priority. Leave it empty and nothing is measured — SLA stays off until you set a number.
vocabadmin.slaTrackHint: A track can set its own number for a priority; where it does, the track's number wins.
vocabadmin.slaResolution: Track override, then this default, then no deadline.
vocabadmin.measuredFrom: Quietness is measured from the last update; the service deadline from the day it was created.
vocabadmin.resetBody: Its label, colour and day counts go back to the built-in defaults. Items keep the value they hold.
vocabadmin.resetAllTitle: Reset every option in this list?
vocabadmin.resetAllBody: Every label, colour and day count here goes back to the built-in defaults. No item changes value.
vocabadmin.notInstalled: This project doesn't have the vocabulary table yet, so the built-in wording is in use everywhere.
vocabadmin.errLastVisible: At least one option has to stay visible.
vocabadmin.errForbidden: Only admins can change the vocabulary.
